messages:
Emma (Sales): FYI GreenCity Health just asked for CCPA residency confirmation for the POC and a signed third-party pen-test letter. They want a single handoff bundle they can send to procurement.
Raj (Solutions): Got it. Do they need GovCloud only, or any specific region?
Emma (Sales): They said US-only / CCPA. Prefer GovCloud or single-tenant staging if possible. Also asked about SAML metadata and a network diagram.
Sofia (Security): For CCPA residency we can provide the data residency statement + current SOC 2 summary report (redacted). For pen-test: we have an internal pentest attestation that we can sign today, but they specifically asked for a third-party letter.
Ben (Eng): Technical ask: they want EKS worker egress IPs to be whitelisted and a presigned upload flow for evidence. We can produce an IP-range list and a sample presigned URL script. Example snippet: ```bash
# generate presigned URL (python boto3)
import boto3
s3=boto3.client('s3')
url=s3.generate_presigned_url('put_object', Params={'Bucket':'redwood-evidence','Key':'green_city/pc_2025.zip'}, ExpiresIn=3600)
print(url)
```
Raj (Solutions): Good. Can Security provide the signed internal attestation now so Sales can unblock procurement, and separately work the third-party letter timeline? Customer will accept a near-term attestation + third-party letter later.
Sofia (Security): Yes we can: 1) immediate internal attestation (signed PDF) 2) redacted SOC2 summary (PDF) 3) network diagram (SVG/PDF) 4) SAML metadata + instructions. For the third-party pen-test letter we need to schedule with our vendor (RedTeamCo). ETA ~10 business days for the letter once vendor slot is confirmed.
Emma (Sales): Can we make the immediate bundle available by EOD Thursday? Customer SLA is tight.
Ben (Eng): I can assemble the network diagram and egress IP ranges by tomorrow noon. I can also produce the presigned-upload example as a ZIP.
Sofia (Security): I'll draft the internal attestation template and run it by legal. If legal sign-off is quick, I can attach the signed PDF by Thursday afternoon. Note: internal attestation explicitly states this is not a third-party pen-test.
ComplianceBot: SOC2 summary (redacted) v2024-10 and internal-attestation-template v1.2 are available in /secure-share/proofs (access: sales@redwood).
Raj (Solutions): Action items: Ben - network diagram + presigned script (due tomorrow 12:00). Sofia - internal attestation + redacted SOC2 (due Thu 17:00). Emma - confirm with GreenCity that internal attestation + SOC2 summary will unblock procurement and that they accept third-party letter to follow.
Emma (Sales): I'll confirm now, pinging @green_city_procurement. :eyes: Will update thread.
Sofia (Security): One more thing - if they insist on continuous GovCloud-only tenancy we need legal to sign an addendum; that could add 2-3 weeks. Flagging risk. :warning:
Emma (Sales): Noted, I'll keep that as a conditional ask. If they push GovCloud-only we'll escalate.
Raj (Solutions): If they need the third-party letter faster we can offer a paid expedited slot with RedTeamCo; cost estimate unknown until we get their calendar.
Emma (Sales): Thanks everyone. I'll update with procurement reply. If anyone hits blockers DM me. :thumbsup:
